description: This EOB holds an adult preventive visit with a flu shot, an emergency room visit with an out-of-network physician, and an acupuncture visit past the visit limit. It carries three errors: cost sharing on the preventive visit, the emergency physician denied for no prior authorization, and the acupuncture denial note without its plan section. Each of the three should be flagged.
